curve-lab · short arcs

Rosettes from a 45 or 90 degree arc

One log-aesthetic arc of 45 or 90 degrees, repeated N times at 360/N about its own centroid. The count under each plate is where neighbouring petals cross: once per join for three or more copies, twice for two.

The family runs from p = -3 to p = 3. p = 0 is the circle, which is congruent under rotation; p = 1 is the log spiral, the self-similar member, whose petals are scaled copies and so nest. Generated by scripts/lac_rosettes.py from scripts/lac_generate.py.
